title: Better Mending
description: A small quality of life tweak to the Mending enchantment. Port of the original mod by legobmw99.
body:
# 🔧 Better Mending !

✨ **A faithful port of the original mod:**
👉 [Better Than Mending (by legobmw99)](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-than-mending)

🌐 **Now available on Spigot:**
➡️ [**Download here!**](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/better-mending.112248/)

💻 **Want dev builds?**
🚀 [Check GitHub releases!](https://github.com/Paulem79/BetterMending/releases/latest)

---

## ✅ What does it do?

This plugin adds **one powerful feature**:
➡️ **Sneak + Right-Click** a Mending item to repair it using **your stored XP** 💎

🔧 Features included:

* ⚙️ Fully customizable **config file**
* 🔑 Built-in **permissions support**
* ✨ Visual **effects when repairing**
* 🌍 Advanced **Multi-language support**

---

## 🌍 New translation system ! (in 3.0.0 and after)

* 🖥️ **Automatic Client Language:** The plugin automatically detects the Minecraft client language of each player and sends messages in their preferred language.
* 💾 **Player language** Players can manually change their language via /btm language CODE !
* 🎨 **Formatting:** All translation files can be fully customized
* 🔄 **Smart Auto-Updates (Versioning):** Whenever the plugin is updated, newly added translation keys are automatically appended to your existing files. **Your custom modifications will never be overwritten!**
* 🔒 **Universal Default Option:** You can enforce a single "universal language" for all players on the server.

---

## 🛡️ Permissions

```yaml
btm.use                     # Allows using the mending ability via right-click
btm.use.auto-repair         # Allows inventory auto-repair with mending
btm.commands.btm            # Controls the /btm toggle command (enable/disable skill)
btm.commands.btm.language   # Controls the /btm language command
btm.commands.btm.admin      # Controls admin commands like /btm reload
